description: This Java class 'SessionManager' manages a media session as a queue, supporting operations like enqueue, remove, pause, resume, stop, and session management. It interacts with a Player interface for media playback and handles playlist and session state, including callbacks for playlist changes and playback events.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: Manages a media session queue, handles playlist operations, session lifecycle, and interacts with a Player for media playback.

methods.name: SessionManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with a name.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a session is currently valid.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current session ID as a string if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: getCurrentItem
methods.description: Retrieves the current playlist item.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns cached statistics info from the Player.

methods.name: getPlaylist
methods.description: Returns the current playlist.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously updates playlist status and triggers playlist readiness callback.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a media item to the playlist with URI and MIME type.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a media item with URI, MIME type, and a PendingIntent receiver.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a playlist item by ID.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position within a playlist item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a playlist item by ID.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and clears playlist.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a new media session, returning session ID.

methods.name: endSession
methods.description: Ends the current session.

methods.name: getSessionStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the session.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends playback, saving current state and position.

methods.name: unsuspend
methods.description: Resumes playback on a new player/route.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Callback for playback error.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Callback for playback completion.

methods.name: onPlaylistChanged
methods.description: Callback when playlist changes.

methods.name: onPlaylistReady
methods.description: Callback when playlist is ready, triggers UI update.

methods.name: setPlayer
methods.description: Sets the Player instance for playback control.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for UI updates on state changes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the media queue.
